g
Switching vehicle into update mode

hicle State Manager
shall change vehicle's state and its
ECUs
in the right update
mode in order to avoid any timeout issues during update.
⌋
(RS_UCM_00037)
This vehicle state change could be triggered based on UCM Master State Machine.
7.2.6.4 Flashing Adapter
Flashing Adapter is an application that is used in the case
UCM Master
is updating a
AUTOSAR Classic Platform
or any platform that can be flashed using diagnostic.
It contains OEM specific diagnostic sequences and communicates via
ara::com
with
the
UCM Master
and the
AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform
, and uses an implemen-
tation of diagnostic protocol data unit application programming interface (
D-PDU API
)
to communicate with Classic ECUs over the Vehicle Bus.
